description: §7.3.3 — shadowing in a NESTED block is legal: an `if` body re-declaring parameter `w` and outer `let v` compiles and runs; the outer bindings are unchanged after the block. out = "shadow-w;shadow-v;v;".
rationale: §7.3.3: shadowing in a nested block (an if / loop / arm body declaring a name the enclosing block or the parameter list binds) is legal and unaffected.
